name: Saida Tatsuki
source:
"They only see what's on my outside, they don't care about what's on the inside. Always."

He usually seems tired, but once he ignites, for better or for worse, he displays his tremendous ability to take action. He seems laidback, but is actually logical and stubborn. He is very good looking.

Image color: Gold, yellow
Image flower: Chrysanthemum

[Translated from [url=https://note.com/nananote07/n/nee97c8c75aa2]Note[/url]]
